_meta.note: Recipes verified against SWT 3.0 production screens (1,233 frames scanned, 2026-11-10). Resolve with: python3 registry/plan.py <recipe> --program SWT --menu Bookings

app-shell.title: Kerangka halaman 1440×900 (Rail + Sidebar + Header Nav + Body)
app-shell.when: Setiap layar aplikasi (478 layar di SWT 3.0).

Header.note: verified: 478/478 screens use Header Nav Breadcrumb=1 in the Header slot

Body.note: Body 1096×792. Mulai dengan SHIELD Page Header (judul, 40–56px) lalu section.

notes: Rail.Active, Sidebar & Open Menu ditentukan modul: lihat patterns/module.py <modul> atau recipes.json → modules.
Tinggi frame mengikuti isi (900–2364); Page Layout Template ikut membesar.
Header slot = SHIELD Header Nav {Breadcrumb=1} (bukan Page Header).

list-page.title: Halaman daftar + tabel
list-page.when: Booking list, Training Results, Asset/User/Rank, Activity Log, Settings tabel (≈120 layar di SWT 3.0).

Content.note: tabel keluarga GUN (find.py table <topik> --lib GUN), State=Filled|Empty|Search-Empty

bodyPrefix.note: opsional: ada di ≈120 layar; layar list tanpa Page Header memakai Section Header di dalam Section Layout - Table

notes: Pagination ada di dalam Section Layout - Table kecuali Table is = No Pagin.
Filter, form Add/Edit, dan konfirmasi adalah FRAME TERPISAH bertipe overlay (lihat overlay-drawer/overlay-modal).

create-wizard.title: Alur buat/ubah multi-langkah
create-wizard.when: 265 frame (Create Booking 5 langkah, Onboarding 4 langkah, Edit Detail List).

Header.note: Onboarding: Header Nav - Onboarding {Program=SWT-Collective|SWT-Marksmanship}; Ongoing: Header Nav - Ongoing Session

Body.note: Langkah 1: kolom 640 (Wrapper) berisi GUN 'Create Booking SWT - Step 1 - …'. Langkah Nominal Roll: Row 1392 dengan Column 288 (Section Layout - Table kecil) + Column 1080 (Page Header + Section Layout - Table).

notes: Langkah SWT: 1 Create Booking → 2 Schedule → 3 Lane Config → 4 Nominal Roll → 5 Review (Modal).

confirm-modal.title: Dialog konfirmasi
confirm-modal.when: Hapus, arsipkan, batalkan, reset password, discard.

tree.note: Varian lain: Modal Confirmation - Remove / Move to archive / Restore from archive / Cancel Booking / Reset Password / Bulk / Discard. Sudah termasuk Scrim 1440×900.

generic.note: untuk kasus di luar katalog domain; tambahkan SHIELD Scrim di belakangnya

confirm-modal.note: Gabung dengan overlay-modal. Domain: GUN Modal Confirmation - <Delete|Remove|Move to archive|…> sudah memasang teks.

form-modal.title: Modal berisi form
domain: GUN:Modal - SWT - Import Nominal Roll (Single CW)

form-field.title: Field formulir
form-field.when: Input teks/angka, area teks, select, tanggal, checkbox, radio, toggle.

select.note: nilai 'Collopsed' memang typo di library (F-40); pakai persis

date.note: jangan pakai set legacy '.Date Picker - Month', '.Datetime Picker', '.xDate Picker - Booking'

radio.note: nama set memiliki spasi di akhir: 'Radio '

notes: Status=danger/warning/success/info untuk validasi; teks bantu lewat Caption Text.
Ukuran default set sering 'sm'; selalu set Size eksplisit ('md*' = default produk).

feedback.title: Umpan balik: toast, alert, empty state

then.note: Day: Calendar Booking List - Day New; Week: Week New; Month: Month SWT. Peringatan F-56: kartu kalender SHIELD menyarangkan Badge GUN.

list-page-tabs.title: Daftar dengan tab di atas tabel

detail-tabs.title: Detail dengan tab (Booking Details, Training Result Details)
detail-tabs.when: ≈100 layar. Page Header + Tab Group v2 + konten per tab.

body.note: Left Content Item: Booking Details | Assignment Details | Asset Details | User | Base Station…

then.note: tab terbanyak dipakai: 4 tab tanpa margin (110), 2 tab dengan margin (93), 8 tab (30)

detail-sections.title: Detail/pengaturan berbasis section
detail-sections.when: Settings (General/Notification), Asset Details, User Details, Asset Tracking.

then.note: ulangi; 2 kolom 536+536 pada Row, atau 1096 penuh
isi section; User Details memakai 32 Key Value
juga Week/Range/Month; State Empty|Hover|If Tab Inactive|End of Day

overlay-drawer.title: Drawer kanan (filter, tambah/ubah, detail ringkas)
overlay-drawer.when: 181 frame. Frame 1440×900 TERPISAH dari halaman, hanya berisi Drawer Right + Scrim.

Slot.note: isi: GUN Filter - SWT - <halaman> | Add Trainee SWT | SHIELD Input-Summary (Read Only) | Alert - Booking Conflict with Blackout | Listbox New. Header: SHIELD Drawer Header

notes: Jangan menumpuk drawer di dalam frame halaman; buat frame overlay sendiri bernama 'Drawer - <tujuan>' (mis. Drawer - Filter, Drawer - Filter - Selected).

tree.note: Status terbanyak: Warning sm (49), Danger sm (13), Warning md (10), Neutral sm (5)

alt.note: Modal besar: lg (47×), xs (18×), md (14×), full (6×); header SHIELD Modal Header; domain: GUN Modal - SWT - Import Nominal Roll…, Booking - Select Courseware Modal
